actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: In round 3, Resident3 contributed more than 30 units, so I punish the highest offending resident with the maximum severity affordable (floor(wallet/0.3)=246). I also broadcast a discouraging message as required.

message.reasoning:

So we must punish that resident with maximum severity we can afford. We can choose one target? Rule says punish that resident (the one contributed >30). Might pick any such resident. Choose Resident3 perhaps. Severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). wallet=74.08, cost 0.3 => max severity = floor(74.08/0.3)= floor(246.933)=246. So punishment amount = severity? The action uses "amount" which is severity. Must ensure cost = amount * punishment_cost = 246*0.3=73.8 which is <= wallet 74.08, okay. So we can punish Resident3 with amount 246. That will reduce Resident3 wallet by 246 (to zero). Good.

Also broadcast discouraging message.

Thus actions: punish Resident3 amount 246, broadcast message.
